advice_items.quote: I was bankrupt twice, sued 24 times... the genius thing I [did] is never quit
advice_items.summary_en: Never quit even after going bankrupt twice and facing 24 lawsuits.
advice_items.summary_zh: 永不放弃，经历破产与官司仍坚持到底

advice_items.canonical_tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
advice_items.quote: is it the most important thing... I've had bad experiences with partners... have complete ownership, personally yes
advice_items.summary_en: Vet business partners carefully or maintain full ownership after bad experiences.
advice_items.summary_zh: 慎选商业合伙人，最好保持完全控股

advice_items.quote: most people are scared of losing money for me it's just money it's like so what just money let's make more of it
advice_items.summary_en: Do not fear losing money or failing; stay aggressive and focus on making more.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不怕赔钱与失败，将其视为常态并勇于进攻

advice_items.quote: my first year I was rejected 617 times... every no is one step closer... that's the best lesson I've ever had
advice_items.summary_en: Treat every rejection as one step closer to success and the best lesson available.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把每一次拒绝当作成功阶梯与最佳课程

advice_items.quote: train your mind harder than your body never accept someone else limitation
advice_items.summary_en: Train your mind harder than your body and refuse to accept others' limitations.
advice_items.summary_zh: 锤炼强大心智，永不接受别人的设限

advice_items.summary_en: Stay obsessed with your mission and never become complacent.
advice_items.summary_zh: 对目标保持痴迷，永不轻易满足

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身中产工薪家庭，早年两次破产、被起诉24次、因合伙人问题背负180万至400万美元债务，创业第一年被拒绝617次仍绝不放弃，最终拥有全球最大水上乐园并实现单年八位数收入。
guests.guest_name: Dubai World's Largest Water Park Owner ('Aquaman')
guests.role_or_title: Owner of the world's largest water park
guests.wealth_detail: Eight figures in a single year (stated by host); previously $1.8M–$4M in debt

advice_items.quote: whatever you want you can have it as long as you're willing to bleed for what you're asking
advice_items.summary_en: You can achieve anything you want if you are willing to bleed and pay the price for it.
advice_items.summary_zh: 想拥有梦想生活，必须愿为目标流血并付出代价

advice_items.quote: I'm willing to lock myself in go monk mode don't see friends for 6 months don't be with no chicks
advice_items.summary_en: Sacrifice short-term social distractions and enter monk mode to become your future self.
advice_items.summary_zh: 戒除社交诱惑进入闭关状态，聚焦未来蜕变

advice_items.quote: if you don't want any haters then becoming successful is not for you... there's no better feeling than proving the ones wrong that doubted you
advice_items.summary_en: Accept haters as part of success and use doubters' skepticism to fuel your drive.
advice_items.summary_zh: 无视质疑与黑粉，把看轻转化为证明自己的动力

guests.first_money_or_break: 创立时尚品牌Ion，创业六年期间忍受外界与亲友质疑并闭关苦干，今年单年营收/收入达到3000万美元，并用60万美元现金购入劳斯莱斯。
guests.wealth_detail: $30M in a single year (this year); bought $600k Rolls-Royce in cash

advice_items.quote: music was my first foray into any kind of success, you know, I was obsessed with music as a kid
advice_items.summary_en: Use deep childhood obsession with your craft as the springboard for your first breakthrough.
advice_items.summary_zh: 从小对所选领域保持痴迷，以此开启事业突破

advice_items.quote: everybody washes their car... even during the pandemic people were washing their cars... it's been recession proof
advice_items.summary_en: Build everyday essential cash-flow businesses like car washes that stay resilient in recessions and pandemics.
advice_items.summary_zh: 投资洗车店等刚需现金流生意，穿越经济周期

advice_items.quote: essentially you're owning a piece of land... just being real estate you know as time progresses it just appreciates in value
advice_items.summary_en: Operate businesses on land you own so the underlying real estate appreciates over time.
advice_items.summary_zh: 结合实体生意持有土地房产，享受长期资产增值

advice_items.quote: we pay attention to details so every customer experience we treat it like it's our last chance at having that customer
advice_items.summary_en: Outperform competitors through meticulous attention to detail and treating every customer as vital.
advice_items.summary_zh: 注重细节并提供极致客户体验，建立竞争壁垒

advice_items.quote: I always have somebody else make the offer first... you cannot be desperate... coming from a position of power is always the better route
advice_items.summary_en: Let the other side make the first offer, counter higher, and pause rather than appearing desperate.
advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判时让对方先出价，保持从容不显急迫

advice_items.quote: what you're not changing you're choosing... if you don't feel like you have enough money and you're not trying to change that you're choosing to be broke
advice_items.summary_en: Take action to change any circumstance you dislike, because inaction is choosing to stay broke.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不去改变的现状就是你的选择，想变富必须行动

guests.first_money_or_break: 从小痴迷音乐并借此获得人生首次成功，随后跨界创业，目前已拥有13家公司及约65家洗车店，单年最高收入达3000万美元。
guests.role_or_title: Musician & Entrepreneur (Owner of 13 businesses and ~65 car washes)
guests.wealth_detail: $30M in a single year; hundreds of millions over career (host-stated); owns 13 businesses & ~65 car washes
guests.zero_start_advice: 对20岁从零开始的自己说：你不去改变的现状，就是你主动做出的选择；如果不满足于目前的收入或生活，就必须立刻行动去改变。

advice_items.quote: if a bank says I'm only going to take 1% of your money for managing all your things that's not 1% of your money that's probably 95% of your income that you would have had in your lifetime
advice_items.summary_en: Recognize how seemingly small bank management fees and taxes silently wipe out most lifetime wealth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 警惕银行管理费与高税率对长期财富的隐形吞噬

advice_items.quote: you would have 96% less... because they took away your compounding effect... the compounding comes with the growing base
advice_items.summary_en: Protect your capital base because long-term compounding depends on an uninterrupted growing base.
advice_items.summary_zh: 复利爆发靠持续扩大的本金，避免中途损耗基数

advice_items.quote: negotiations are won by the people who don't need the deal who could just walk away... be diplomatic never be disrespectful but put yourself into their shoes after the deal
advice_items.summary_en: Win negotiations by being willing to walk away while staying diplomatic and framing your stance around the counterparty's post-deal interests.
advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判胜在敢于离场，同时立足对方长远利益博弈

guests.first_money_or_break: 曾创立并高价退出一家公司，单年最高收入达数亿美元。
guests.guest_name: Dubai Exited CEO (Hundreds of Millions in a Year)
guests.wealth_detail: Hundreds of millions in a single year; exited a company
